orientation: A.1 governs how the Atlas is read, amended and enforced. Its distinctive move is to concede that subjectivity cannot be eliminated, and to shift the governed quantity from correctness to inferential distance from explicit text — which is what the whole supporting-document apparatus (Annotations, Original Context Data, Tenets, Scenarios) exists to minimize. The Executive process is the sharpest security engineering in the corpus: adversarial validation by mandate, Crafter and Reviewer anchored to different source documents, and emergency bypasses built as one-directional ratchets toward restriction.
